set.body:
Owner: ScalaFIM shared surface viewer/compiler, JavaFX, Three.js and reference raster backends. Consumer: PLS Neuro bd-01M1YEC2V9X0K7KF8SN321VR82. This is a missing general capability, not an app-specific geometry transform.

Current recovery source at066be6c plus retained-atlas follow-up still has one SurfaceViewerState.camera and one SurfaceRenderPlan.camera. SurfaceViewSlot has only viewport and world translation. The app's Both + Left side sets a single Lateral(Left) viewpoint: left lateral/right medial, not two lateral faces. Source: SurfaceViewTypes.scala, SurfaceViewer.scala, SurfaceRenderPlan.scala, SurfaceCompiler.compileUnsafe/fitCamera; JavaFX configureCamera/configureLayout; ThreeSurfaceProgram.UpdateCamera and reference raster projection. Existing app screenshots: output/brain-display/layout-28 and adoption-26. Main a2d6f95 lacks even the newer recovery camera fixes; choose an explicit integration base and preserve both existing scientific and qualified affine work.

Implement an explicit shared contract for per-surface/view-slot camera orientation, with a common navigation policy where desired. Paired lateral means Lateral(Left) and Lateral(Right); paired medial means Medial(Left) and Medial(Right). Never mirror scientific vertices or label one global camera as both lateral. Retain original geometry, sampling coordinates, surface/vertex/face IDs and barycentric picks. Persist the policy and orientation state with backward-compatible decoding for old single-camera scenes. Global and per-view reset/orbit/zoom behavior must be explicit.

All rendering and picking paths must consume the same effective slot camera. Include compiler fitting across the displayed geometries, camera/layout resource keys and incremental dirty accounting so ordinary recoloring does not recreate cameras or meshes. Preserve physical aspect and margins on resize, projection/depth behavior, display-only offsets, failure atomicity and mounted scene lifecycle. Continue using the qualified affine/no-mipmap/centroid color contract where selected; this feature does not admit scalar-fragment approximation.

Acceptance: independent asymmetric left/right geometry confirms true lateral and medial view directions; native/framebuffer and original-ID picks agree per slot before/after orbit, resize, reorder, geometry switch and save/reopen. Test isolated and bilateral presentations at wide/narrow and1x/2x sizes, perspective/orthographic projection, clipping/depth and resource reuse. Required shared JVM/JS plus affected backend suites must pass; Three native proof and JavaFX scene evidence remain distinct. Actual standard-template/real-cortex app integration is a separate consumer gate. No implementation, source edits or main integration is claimed by this ticket.
set.title: Support paired lateral and medial surface cameras with per-slot render and pick correspondence
